name: Kh.Kim
summary:
I have worked as a frontend engineer since 2020.

My recent work covers Vuddy's purchase and order flows and Samantha's real-time chat and content-management interfaces. I build both customer-facing products and the tools used to operate them.

I studied HCI and Visual Analytics in graduate school before moving into product engineering. Since then I have worked on AutoML, content platforms, commerce, and AI character chat products. A recurring part of my work is clarifying expected behavior when product requirements, designs, and APIs do not line up cleanly.
